description: Provenance pin for infra/cloudflare/terraform/.terraform.lock.hcl (V2.1 slice 06). The lockfile is the one `tofu init` wrote in the live fire (2026-09-28); its SHA-256 equals the live fire's own record (the maintainer's evidence, init-validate/lockfile.sha256). test/unit/v21-lockfile.test.mjs requires the committed lockfile to match this pin, so any hash drift fails. A new provider version is a reviewed change to both files, never an automatic re-lock.
